description: Defines a template-based message exchange mechanism with Type-Length-Value serialization, including nested classes for Request, Response, and Buffer, as well as a core MessageExchangeType class managing communication state and data flow.

classes.name: TypeLengthValueType
classes.description: Template struct implementing TLV serialization with nested Request, Response, and Buffer classes.

classes.name: MessageExchangeType
classes.description: Template class managing message exchange, including link, open/close, flush, submit, and exchange operations, with internal state handling and data serialization.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the TLV data into a stream buffer.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another Request object if types match.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances to the next buffer block if available.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a stream buffer into internal TLV structure.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data through the underlying channel.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the underlying channel and processes it.
